The objective is for the team to learn how to communicate clearly and effectively, in turn creating a culture of mutual understanding and respect. 

### Why is it important?

By learning how to communicate effectively, the team can improve their ability to understand each other's points of view. Establishing good communication behaviors and expectations on the team will set the stage for better understanding between members, limit frustrating interactions, and improve team effectiveness.

### Learn about how your team members communicate

People process and share information in different ways, and often what is energizing for one person can be draining for another. For example, extroverts gravitate towards groups and tend to think out loud. Introverts, on the other hand, work more slowly and deliberately, and can get frustrated when they don't have time to prepare or complete a task before jumping to the next one. Understand that people thrive in different circumstances, and make sure you create space for different work styles. 

### Practice these key communication skills

Keep this list of [Team Communication Do's and Don'ts](Team_Communication_Dos_and_Donts "Team Communication Do's and Don'ts") handy. Practice these techniques with your team, encouraging your team members by appreciating and acknowledging their efforts to improve communication.

### Create a feedback loop

At the end of each week, get together as a group to discuss how well you are communicating as a team and what you can continue to work on.
